name: Freeze Out Dominoes
description: Freeze-Out Dominoes is a simple children's domino game similar to the card game War. Players arrange dominoes face-down in a line and reveal tiles in turn. The player whose tile matches one of the suits shown in a trick takes all revealed dominoes. It emphasizes chance over strategy, making it ideal for young players learning domino games.

content.text: Freeze-Out Dominoes is a simple children's domino game similar to the card game War. Players arrange dominoes face-down in a line and reveal tiles in turn. The player whose tile matches one of the suits shown in a trick takes all revealed dominoes. It emphasizes chance over strategy, making it ideal for young players learning domino games.
Freeze-Out Dominoes is a modern children's game modeled after the card game War. It was likely designed to teach young players the fundamentals of domino games and matching mechanics.
Shuffle all dominoes face-down. Distribute evenly among players. If dominoes don't divide evenly, remove extras from play. Each player arranges their dominoes face-down in a horizontal line.

items.text: Highest Tile in Suit: The lead player announces a single suit, and the trick is won by the highest-value domino in that suit among those revealed (not the first match).
Cumulative Score Variant: Instead of playing until one player has all dominoes, play multiple rounds (5-10) and award 1 point per domino captured each round. Highest score after all rounds wins.
Two-Player Freeze-Out: Standard rules with just two players. Each draws 7-10 dominoes depending on preference.
